error_reason: The WebSurfer agent incorrectly mapped the generic 'other' file extension label in the Arxiv interface to '.ps' without explicit verification, causing it to count all non-PDF files (97) instead of verifying if they were actually PostScript versions of the January 2020 Lattice QCD articles (31). This was the earliest step where an unverified assumption directly led to the wrong final count.
